stories.title: EU cyber rules put crypto wallet makers on 24-hour reporting clock
stories.sum: Crypto wallet providers must submit an early vulnerability report within 24 hours and a full notification within 72 hours of exploits, or risk administrative fines of as much as $17.3 million.

stories.title: Brooklyn Museum, American Folk Art Museum, and Whitney Museum Unions Vote in Favor of Strikes
stories.sum: The respective unions voted in favor of strike action if they do not receive satisfactory offers on their contracts, Local 2110 UAW announced today.

stories.title: Bitcoin and crypto stock prices today: Investors are on edge ahead of crucial ‘Clarity Act’ Senate vote
stories.sum: The crypto world has one thing on its mind today: Will the Clarity Act advance in the U.S. Senate? Over a year after its introduction, the Clarity Act is finally up for a vote in the Senate.

stories.title: The Elusive Choreographer Sarah Michelson Is Turning MoMA Into a Dance Palace
stories.source: The New York Times — Art & Design
stories.sum: Sarah Michelson presents her expansive vision of dance at the Museum of Modern Art, where she will take over the atrium in her exhibition, “nowhere.”

stories.title: AI models need more data about biology, and OpenAI is paying to create it
stories.sum: Last year, the clinical trial policy analyst Ruxandra Teslo posted an idea for super-charging medical AI systems: use data from failed biotech companies.

stories.title: Alice Diop to Take on Miu Miu’s 2026 Art Basel Paris Commission
stories.sum: Geste de Consolation (Gesture of Consolation) will be staged at the Palais d’Iéna.

stories.title: Ching-Ling Wang Named Nancy Chang Lee Curator of Chinese Art at Smithsonian
stories.sum: The National Museum of Asian Art (NMAA) at the Smithsonian has appointed Ching-Ling Wang as the inaugural Nancy Chang Lee Curator of Chinese Art. The art historian and curator begins his new role in November.

stories.title: Trump Orders Smithsonian to Replace “Strange Modernist Sculpture” with Three-Story-High Washington Statue
stories.sum: President Donald Trump has demanded that the Smithsonian remove what he described as a “strange modernist sculpture” from outside the National Museum of American History and install a thirty-foot-high “Colossus statue”…

stories.title: Alex Bores Wants Democrats to Make AI Safety a 2028 Election Issue
stories.sum: Alex Bores, who lost a congressional primary contest that revolved around A.I. regulation, is trying to position himself at the center of the conversation for the next presidential election.

stories.title: Macklemore supported by major artists following removal from Ed Sheeran tour for Palestine stance
stories.sum: Kneecap, CMAT, Paloma Faith, Garbage, Zara Larsson and Greta Thunberg have all offered their support to the rapper

stories.title: The Bayeux Tapestry Makes Its Return to England
stories.sum: The Bayeux Tapestry Makes Its Return to England Courtesy of Bayeux Museum The Bayeux Tapestry not only narrates a major historical event but also records information about everyday life in medieval England and France.
also: The New York Times — Art & Design

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV opens a new installation by JR on Vatican Library facade.
stories.sum: Pope Leo XIV marked his 71st birthday on September 14th by opening “AQVA. Catastrophe and Wonder,” a new exhibition at the Vatican Apostolic Library anchored by a monumental installation by the French artist JR .

stories.title: James McNeill Whistler’s Music for the Eyes
stories.sum: A long-awaited Whistler retrospective at Tate Britain makes the case that every brushstroke, color, and omission serves the pursuit of harmony.

stories.title: Knicks Legend Karl-Anthony Towns and Jordyn Woods Curate a Sotheby’s Auction
stories.sum: The couple has handpicked 10 artworks for the auction house's Contemporary Curated sale. The post Knicks Legend Karl-Anthony Towns and Jordyn Woods Curate a Sotheby’s Auction appeared first on Artnet News .

stories.title: Apple releases iOS 27, macOS Golden Gate 27 with Siri AI and Liquid Glass refinements
stories.sum: This is also the last version of macOS to support Rosetta for Intel apps.
